news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 7.7% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. news.title: UGRO Capital Limited (BSE:511742) completed the acquisition of Datasigns Technologies Private Limited from a group of shareholders.
news.body: UGRO Capital Limited (BSE:511742) entered into letter of intent to acquire Datasigns Technologies Private Limited from a group of shareholders for INR 450 million on May 2, 2024. The consideration will be paid by way of a combination of cash consideration and swap of shares up to 678,788 shares at INR 264 per share. Upon completion, Datasigns Technologies Private Limited will operate as a wholly owned subsidiary of UGRO Capital Limited.The transaction has been approved by board of UGRO Capital and is expected to close within 90 days. UGRO Capital Limited entered into Share and purchase agreement to acquire Datasigns Technologies Private Limited from a group of shareholders on January 1, 2025.
